PASS on the fake backend, first gate run: G1-G5 and G9 pass, G6/G7/G8 only warn, no G4 warning. WHAT IT IS: the card's models[0], the MJCF scene pnd_robots/adam_lite/scene.xml, served as the card's family-config MujocoDriver (the decision and the MujocoDriver helper express the real interface; no deviation from the card). The scene and the adam_lite.xml it includes are read in place from the read-only clone at commit 84873eb3c4afd584d468864ba41527a1c14fb688; neither the model nor its assets is copied into the package. The bridge derives cap.world.step.v1 action.ctrl from the model's actuator_ctrlrange: 23 motor actuators (12 leg, 3 waist and 4 per arm; the two wristYaw motors are commented out), with ranges +-230 (hipPitch/kneePitch), +-160 (hipRoll), +-105 (hipYaw), +-40 (anklePitch), +-12 (ankleRoll), +-110 (waist), +-65 (shoulder) and +-30 (elbow). cap.world.reset.v1 restores the model defaults; the world state is the full integration state (30 qpos, 29 qvel, 23 ctrl for the free base plus 23 hinges) with tick and a 1 ms timestep. The card lists five scenes and the upstream config.py defaults to adam_u_omnipicker, but the package follows models[0] as the playbook says; a site can serve another scene by changing model_path. FAKE: MuJoCo is neither installed nor installable where the gate runs, so backends['fake'] is the package's stand-in mujoco module (fake.py), the pattern of the SDK's own MujocoDriver tests. It parses the expanded MJCF for nq/nv/nu, every ctrlrange and the timestep, so the derived contract is the model's, and its integration is a placeholder first-order motion of each actuated hinge (marked '# placeholder' in fake.py) with no mesh, contact, equality, tendon, muscle or gravity. No array is reduced: the fake serves the full 30/29/23 arrays. NOT COVERED: MuJoCo itself, so no trajectory was compared with the real engine; no rendering or viewer, no elastic hoist, joystick or DDS/ROS2 bridge, no contact physics, and no physical Adam-Lite hardware (none was attached and nothing was validated against it). WARNINGS, all expected for a simulator family (PLAYBOOK section 8): G6.NOT_RECORDED and G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND because the fake is a stand-in for the mujoco library rather than a package class the gate records, so native calls and the fake surface are not checked; G8.NO_UNIT x3 for the bridge-derived integer inputs ticks and reset seed and for the unitless model action.ctrl (the MJCF ctrlrange names no unit, which the facts.md units paragraph states). The upstream simulator needs pnd_sdk_python, a DDS/ROS2 interface and MuJoCo 3.2.0 (README.md:12-13 and simulate_python/pnd_mujoco.py:5-11); none is installed or imported by this package. The package is model-authored (driver.lock.json authored_by kind model) and unreviewed (reviewed_by null); no hardware run is claimed.
